1 "It is, therefore, Most Respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may very kindly be pleased to allow the present application and quash the impugned order dated 26.7.2023 passed by the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 9, Allahabad in Criminal Case No. 402 of 2023 (State of U.P. vs. Siddharth Yadav@Sani and others), arising out of Case Crime No. 0235 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504,

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 9, Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Criminal Case No. 402 of 2023 (State of U.P. vs. Siddharth Yadav@Sani and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It is further prayed that this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to direct the Court below to pass appropriate order with regard to the further investigation of the matter in pursuance to the original application as presented by the applicant for lodging her first information report, otherwise the applicant will suffer great irreparable loss and injury, and/or pass such other suitable order or direction which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper under the facts and circumstances of the case."
4.

At the very outset learned counsel for the applicant submits that he does not intend to press the present petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. and he submits that the purpose of the applicant would suffice if an inquiry as ordered by the Superintendent of Police (Yamunapar), District Prayagraj vide order dated 22.4.2022 on the application of the applicant Smt. Yogita Yadav dated 22.4.2022, is directed to be done and a report of the same is submitted before the concerned officer and more particularly the said order passed on the said application which is annexure no. 7 to the affidavit in support of the present petition, is concluded and a report is forwarded to the concerned superior authority at the earliest.
5. Learned A.G.A. submits that he has no objection to the said proposition.
6. In view of the same the prayer in the present application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. is dismissed as not pressed.

An inquiry on the application dated 22.4.2022 being annexure no. 7 to the affidavit given by the applicant Smt.Yogita Yadav and the order passed by Superintendent of Police, Yamunapar,
District Prayagraj on 22.4.2022 directing an inquiry within 05 days and submitting a report of the same which is on the face of the said application itself, is directed to be concluded within a period of three weeks and a report be submitted before the concerned officer in accordance with law, if not already done.
7. The present application is disposed of.

( Samit Gopal,J.) Order Date :- 12.4.2024 Naresh  Smt Yogita Yadav vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 12 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110311768/
